_metadata.description: The four UI surfaces — traceability matrix, fleet view, wizard, finding docs — plus i18n, selectors, and BAS coverage.

requirements.title: Traceability matrix view
requirements.description: OT × requirement grid with evidence status cells, unproven-claim emphasis, drill-in to requirement detail (validation refs, evidence history, manual attestations + expiry), and a scenario picker.

validation.notes: Render + drill-in + emphasis states against fixture data.
BAS: deep-link matrix render happy path (grid + registry summary).

requirements.title: Fleet view
requirements.description: Worst-first table with as-of stamps, laggard filters (starter-registry / template-version / unproven-claims), and row navigation into the per-scenario matrix.

requirements.title: Wizard UI with diff preview
requirements.description: The interview flow renders with live section preview and a diff preview before apply; sessions are resumable from where the CLI left off.

validation.notes: BAS: wizard happy path (pick scenario, start session, interview renders).

requirements.title: Finding docs deep-linked with fix affordance
requirements.description: Every finding code renders its docs/findings/<code>.md remediation doc in-app; validation results link findings → docs → PreviewFix diff → explicit apply.

validation.notes: Doc rendering per code; fix affordance flow.

requirements.title: i18n, selectors, and BAS coverage
requirements.description: en/ar/ja locales with zero hardcoded strings (i18n lint clean); selectors manifest for BAS; bas/ cases + seeds for matrix render, wizard happy path, and fix preview/apply; static registration passes regardless of live-run gating.

validation.notes: Selector manifest integrity; i18n lint in the UI suite; BAS static registration via scenario test.
